$comment: The one redirect source for this site (brand/SITEMAP.md E4). Old path -> new path, both relative to the site root. GitHub Pages: built as static redirect pages. Cloudflare: import as bulk 301s.

$host.$comment: The domain move (2026-10-29 cutover). Every path keeps its name; only the host and the /dom-virus base change. GitHub Pages answers the old address with a 301 to the custom domain once it is set in Settings -> Pages, so this entry is documentation for the Cloudflare step-up (one bulk redirect), not a built page.

$whileHidden.$comment: Built only while the build hides the route (an unready game or a post about it, production only; site-kit/lifecycle.mjs). These were live on domvirus.com before DOM Kaiju went back to staging. Staging, or production once the game is published, serves the pages themselves.
